title: Customer Delete grants delete of customer records only (not payments)
expected: User can delete customer records but not customer payments (payments require Invoicing Delete).
actual: With customersDelete granted and Tech assigned (hydrated perms=[customersView,customersCreateAndEdit,customersDelete]), Tech deleted a throwaway ZZAUTOTEST customer via customers/delete -> HTTP 201. Delete capability confirmed. Note: backend authorizes customer delete at customersCreateAndEdit level (delete also succeeds with Edit but no Delete perm; View-only=403), so the granular customersDelete toggle is a front-end gate; grant path works as expected.
reason: Positive delete executed on throwaway customer (HTTP 201); matches expected 'user can delete customer records'
config: perms=[customersView, customersCreateAndEdit, customersDelete]

title: Sensitive customer fields gated by Manage AP/AR, not Customer permission
expected: Sensitive customer fields remain gated by View and Manage AP/AR Data regardless of Customer View.
config: perms=[customersView] cross={"seeApArData":false}

title: Part Sales Delete grants delete sales and reverse part-sale invoices
expected: User can delete part sales and reverse part-sale invoices.
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Parts Department ON. See Financial Data ON. Part Sales: Delete ON (Edit+View auto). All other permissions OFF.

title: Catalog & Inventory Delete grants delete parts from catalog
expected: User can delete parts from the catalog.
actual: Role granted [settingsParts,catalogInventoryView/Edit/Delete], Tech hydrated. Tech deleted throwaway ZZAUTOTEST catalogue part via parts-catalogue/remove-catalogue-part -> HTTP 200. Matches expected 'user can delete parts from the catalog'.
reason: Positive delete executed on throwaway catalogue part (HTTP 200)
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Parts Department ON. Catalog & Inventory: Delete ON (Edit+View auto). All other permissions OFF.

title: Vendor & Order Mgmt Delete grants delete vendors and POs
expected: User can delete vendors and delete POs.
actual: Role granted [settingsParts,vendorOrderManagement View/Edit/Delete], Tech hydrated. Tech deleted throwaway ZZAUTOTEST vendor via parts-catalogue/remove-vendor -> HTTP 201. Matches expected 'user can delete vendors'. (PO deletion not separately exercised; vendor-delete capability confirmed on throwaway data.)
reason: Positive delete executed on throwaway vendor (HTTP 201)
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Parts Department ON. Vendor & Order Management: Delete ON (Edit+View auto). All other permissions OFF.

title: Invoicing Delete grants delete payments, void transactions, delete part-sale return
expected: User can delete payments (incl. customer payments), void transactions and delete a part-sale return.
config: Start from blank/no-access role. See Financial Data ON. View and Manage AP/AR Data ON. Work Orders View ON. Invoicing & Payments: Delete ON (Edit+View auto). All other permissions OFF.

title: Cross-dep: deleting a customer payment needs Invoicing Delete (Customer Delete alone insufficient)
expected: Customer Delete alone cannot delete a customer payment; Invoicing Delete is required.
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Customer Management: Delete ON (Edit+View auto). Invoicing & Payments: all OFF. All other permissions OFF.

title: Cross-dep: reversing an invoice needs WO Delete even with Invoicing Edit
expected: Invoice reversal requires WO Delete; Invoicing Edit alone is insufficient.
config: Start from blank/no-access role. See Financial Data ON. Work Orders: View ON, Delete OFF. Invoicing & Payments: Edit ON (View auto). All other permissions OFF.

title: Review Work Orders GRANT — Review option available with WO View + Review
expected: With WO View + Review Work Orders ON (Edit OFF), the user can see and use the Review option on work orders.
config: Work Orders: View = ON; Review Work Orders (woReviewWorkOrders) = ON. All other toggles OFF (incl WO Edit OFF).

title: Review Work Orders WITHHOLD — Review option absent when toggle OFF
expected: With Review Work Orders OFF, the Review option is not available even though WO View is ON.
config: Work Orders: View = ON; Review Work Orders (woReviewWorkOrders) = OFF. All other toggles OFF.

title: Pick Parts GRANT — can pick parts from inventory onto WO line
expected: With WO View + Pick Parts ON (Edit OFF), the user can pick parts from inventory onto a WO line.
config: Work Orders: View = ON; Pick Parts (woPickParts) = ON. All other toggles OFF (incl WO Edit OFF).

title: Pick Parts WITHHOLD — pick action blocked/absent when toggle OFF
expected: With Pick Parts OFF, the user cannot pick parts from inventory onto a WO line.
config: Work Orders: View = ON; Pick Parts (woPickParts) = OFF. All other toggles OFF.

title: Order Parts GRANT — place PO for parts on WO and receive deliveries
expected: With WO View + Order Parts ON (Edit OFF), the user can place a PO linked to the WO and receive parts deliveries onto the WO.
config: Work Orders: View = ON; Order Parts (woOrderParts) = ON. All other toggles OFF (incl WO Edit OFF).

title: Order Parts WITHHOLD — cannot place PO or receive parts when OFF
expected: With Order Parts OFF, the user cannot place a PO for parts on the WO nor receive parts deliveries onto the WO.
config: Work Orders: View = ON; Order Parts (woOrderParts) = OFF. All other toggles OFF.

title: WO sub-settings are INDEPENDENT — enabling one does not enable others
expected: The three WO sub-settings are independent: enabling Pick Parts grants only pick-parts, not Review or Order Parts.
config: Work Orders: View = ON; Pick Parts (woPickParts) = ON; Review Work Orders = OFF; Order Parts = OFF.

title: Return part from WO line requires NO permission (note case)
expected: Returning a part from a WO line requires no specific WO sub-setting permission; it works with only WO View.
config: Work Orders: View = ON; Pick Parts = OFF; Order Parts = OFF; Review = OFF. All WO sub-settings OFF.

title: Customer Portal GRANT — access and manage customer portal config
expected: With Customer Portal ON, the user can access and manage the customer portal configuration.
config: Customer Portal (customerPortal) = ON. All other toggles OFF.

title: Billing Portal GRANT — access and manage billing portal
expected: With Billing Portal ON, the user can access and manage the billing portal.
config: Billing Portal (billingPortal) = ON. All other toggles OFF.

title: Parts Department PRESERVES child settings — OFF then back ON restores prior CRUD
expected: Turning Parts Department OFF preserves child settings, which are restored intact when it is turned back ON.
config: Start with Parts Department ON and specific child CRUD (e.g. Part Sales View+Edit, Catalog & Inventory View, Vendor & Order Management View). Then turn Parts Department OFF, Save; then turn it back ON.

title: Settings parent DEPENDENCY — subs hidden via slide in editor when parent OFF
expected: Sub-settings are slide-hidden in the editor when the Settings parent is OFF and revealed when it is ON.
config: In the role editor: toggle Settings (settings) OFF then ON and observe the sub-setting rows.

title: Integrations sub GRANT — manage QuickBooks, IBS, and Open API
expected: With Integrations ON (parent ON), the user can manage QuickBooks, IBS, and Open API; other subs remain inaccessible. No 'Integrations' sub-setting exists in the role editor (build); Integrations (QuickBooks, IBS) is a top-level Administration area only. [Build-vs-spec: see VIU-12.]
config: Settings (settings) = ON; Integrations (settingsIntegrations) = ON. All other sub-settings OFF.

title: Integrations sub WITHHOLD — area hidden/blocked when settingsIntegrations OFF (parent ON)
expected: With Integrations OFF (parent ON), the Integrations settings area is hidden and direct URL access is blocked. No 'Integrations' sub-setting exists in the role editor (build); Integrations (QuickBooks, IBS) is a top-level Administration area only. [Build-vs-spec: see VIU-12.]
config: Settings (settings) = ON; Integrations (settingsIntegrations) = OFF. All other sub-settings OFF.

title: View/Manage Wages sub GRANT — manage view/manage employee wage rates (sensitive)
expected: With View/Manage Wages ON (parent ON), the user can manage view/manage employee wage rates (sensitive); other subs remain inaccessible.
config: Settings (settings) = ON; View/Manage Wages (settingsWages) = ON. All other sub-settings OFF.

expected: Tech View enforces the restriction: no tech time field is shown.
config: View Mode (viewMode) = tech; Work Orders View = ON; Work Orders Edit = ON. All other toggles OFF.

title: Tech View restriction — Cannot Send to Portal
expected: Tech View enforces the restriction: cannot send to portal.
config: View Mode (viewMode) = tech; Work Orders View = ON; Work Orders Edit = ON. All other toggles OFF.

title: Tech View restriction — Cannot view labor rates
expected: Tech View enforces the restriction: cannot view labor rates.
config: View Mode (viewMode) = tech; Work Orders View = ON; Work Orders Edit = ON. All other toggles OFF.

title: Tech View restriction — Limited parts request form
expected: Tech View enforces the restriction: limited parts request form.
config: View Mode (viewMode) = tech; Work Orders View = ON; Work Orders Edit = ON. All other toggles OFF.

title: Tech View restriction — Cannot edit existing WO lines (create-only)
expected: Tech View enforces the restriction: cannot edit existing wo lines (create-only).
config: View Mode (viewMode) = tech; Work Orders View = ON; Work Orders Edit = ON. All other toggles OFF.

title: Tech View restriction — WO lines read-only after approval
expected: Tech View enforces the restriction: wo lines read-only after approval.
config: View Mode (viewMode) = tech; Work Orders View = ON; Work Orders Edit = ON. All other toggles OFF.

title: Send to Portal appears only in Full View (not Tech) — comparison
expected: Send to Portal is available only in Full View; it is not shown in Tech View.
config: Create two roles: (A) View Mode = full, WO View+Edit ON; (B) View Mode = tech, WO View+Edit ON. Assign each to a separate test user.

title: Financial gate — enabling Part Sales CRUD while Financial OFF triggers confirm modal
expected: Enabling Part Sales CRUD while See Financial Data is OFF triggers the financial confirm modal; confirming enables See Financial Data.
config: In the editor with See Financial Data = OFF, enable Part Sales CRUD; observe the financial confirm modal.

title: Financial gate — enabling Invoicing CRUD while Financial OFF triggers confirm modal
expected: Invoicing requires See Financial Data; enabling its CRUD while Financial OFF triggers the financial confirm modal.
config: In the editor with See Financial Data = OFF, enable Invoicing CRUD; observe the financial confirm modal.

title: Security — no financial leak in Receive Part modal when Financial OFF (SV-7973)
expected: With See Financial Data OFF, the Receive Part modal exposes no financial data (regression guard for SV-7973).
config: See Financial Data (seeFinancialData) = OFF; Work Orders View = ON; Order Parts (woOrderParts) = ON. All other toggles OFF.

title: Manage AP/AR GRANT — Unpaid/Payments/Credits tabs, aging reports, bulk payments
expected: With View and Manage AP/AR Data ON, the Unpaid/Payments/Credits tabs, AP/AR aging reports, and bulk payments are all available.
config: View and Manage AP/AR Data (seeApArData) = ON; Reports = ON; Customer/Vendor View as needed. All other toggles OFF.

title: Manage AP/AR WITHHOLD — tabs, aging reports, and bulk payments hidden when OFF
expected: With View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF, the AP/AR tabs, aging reports, and bulk payments are all hidden.
config: View and Manage AP/AR Data (seeApArData) = OFF; Reports = ON; Customer/Vendor View ON. All other toggles OFF.

title: Manage AP/AR sensitive customer fields — Edit Customer modal + Customer Overview panel
expected: View and Manage AP/AR Data gates the sensitive customer fields on the Edit Customer modal and Customer Overview panel; hidden when OFF, shown when ON.
config: Compare two roles: (A) View and Manage AP/AR Data ON, Customer View+Edit ON; (B) View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF, Customer View+Edit ON.

title: Manage AP/AR does NOT gate CRUD, but Invoicing Delete additionally requires it
expected: View and Manage AP/AR Data does not gate general CRUD, but Invoicing Delete additionally requires it and is blocked when AP/AR is OFF.
config: See Financial Data = ON (required for Invoicing); Invoicing View+Edit+Delete = ON; View and Manage AP/AR Data (seeApArData) = OFF. All other toggles OFF.

title: View History Logs GRANT — history/audit logs shown app-wide
expected: With View History Logs ON, history/audit logs are visible across the app.
config: View History Logs (viewHistoryLogs) = ON; Work Orders View = ON; Parts Department = ON with relevant children View ON. All other toggles OFF.

title: View History Logs WITHHOLD — history/audit logs hidden app-wide when OFF
expected: With View History Logs OFF, history/audit logs are hidden app-wide.
config: View History Logs (viewHistoryLogs) = OFF; Work Orders View = ON; Parts Department = ON with relevant children View ON. All other toggles OFF.
